column1: # Per-source download URLs for each assembly. download_references.sh picks the
# first source in --preferred-source (default: ensembl,ucsc,ncbi) that has a row
# here for the requested assembly (graceful fallback).
# Contig naming after download is normalised transparently by mask_genome.py
# (Ensembl 1/X/Y, UCSC chr1/chrX/chrY, NCBI accessions renamed to chrN), so any
# source works with the same PAR BEDs.
# Ensembl URLs are PINNED to an explicit release-NNN rather than the floating
# current_fasta/ symlink, so a published reference records the exact release it
# came from and can be rebuilt byte-for-byte. Keep these in step with the
# matching GTF rows in config/annotations.tsv: an assembly label like "GRCh38"
# is stable across releases, the sequence is not guaranteed to be.
#   needs_rename   1 if contigs are accessions to remap to chrN (NCBI), else 0
#   release        provider release/version this URL pins (NA when not versioned)
